title: Remaining whole-system transport power and realization identities
statement: The remaining clauses of whole-system point transport: power compatibility, finite evaluation, normalized realization, naturality, compositor compatibility, Frobenius normalization, and reduction realization.

source.place: Assembly steps 2--6, after the naturality and constructibility clauses proved directly in the parent assembly.

proof.text: Apply the whole-system transport descent, power Roos coherence, normalized Roos transport, and the specified integral comparison lemmas. The finite evaluation and realization equations are obtained by the normalized comparison identities; Frobenius and reduction specializations follow from the defining unique section maps and completion counit. This is the unresolved middle and final portion of the blueprint assembly.
